wp25EasterEggs-desc: Kani waa kordhin loogu talagalay dabaaldegga sannad-guurada 25-aad ee Wikipedia iyadoo lagu darayo Ukumo Qarsoon oo is dhexgal leh.
wp25eastereggs-enable-description: Ku xus 25 sano guurada Wikipedia adigoo wata [https://wikimediafoundation.org/wikipedia25/wikipedia-mascot/ saaxiib yar oo qurux badan oo akhriska kugu weheliya]
wp25eastereggs-enable-help: Ku xus 25 sano-guurada Wikipedia adigoo wata saaxiib yar oo qurux badan oo akhriska kugu weheliya
wp25eastereggs-enable-learn-more-link-la: Wax badan ka baro Habka Dhalashada
communityconfiguration-wp25eastereggs-de: Habka Dhalashada waa muuqaal ikhtiyaari ah oo ku-meel-gaar ah, loona sameeyay in lagu xuso sannad-guurada 25-aad ee Wikipedia, isaga oo abuuraya jawi dabaaldeg ah marka la hawlgeliyo.
communityconfiguration-wp25eastereggs-ad:
Marka la shido, waxa uu soo bandhigayaa "Baby Globe", oo ah astaanta dhalashada, taas oo u shaqaynaysa sidii saaxiib akhris, isla markaana furaysa dhaqdhaqaaqyo qarsoon iyo yaabab muuqaal ah oo nooca "easter egg" ah si isticmaalayaashu u ogaadaan. Haddii kordhintan aan la hawlgelin, dejinta muuqaalkeedu uma muuqan doonto akhristayaasha. Wax badan ka baro [https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia_25/Easter_egg_experiments bogga MetaWiki].

Muuqaalkan gaarka ah ee ololaha waxa uu shaqayn doonaa laga bilaabo 16 Febraayo 2026. Taariikhda 6 Abriil 2026, waxa laga saari doonaa dhammaan wiki-yada.
communityconfiguration-wp25eastereggs-en: Hawlgelinta Habka Dhalashada waxay u oggolaanaysaa akhristayaasha inay shitaan ama damiyaan dejin muuqaal oo cinwaankeedu yahay "Habka Dhalashada (Baby Globe)". Marka akhristayaashu hawlgeliyaan "Habka Dhalashada", nooc ka mid ah Baby Globe ayaa ka soo muuqan doona bogagga sida lagu qeexay shaandhooyinka gaarka ah ee dhaqdhaqaaqyada Baby Globe.
communityconfiguration-wp25eastereggs-de: Xaaladda caadiga ah ee Habka Dhalashada
Marka loo dejiyo "Hawlgelan" sida caadiga ah, akhristayaashu weli way damin karaan habka iyagoo adeegsanaya dejimaha muuqaalka, iyo sidoo kale dhinaca kale.
communityconfiguration-wp25eastereggs-en: Waxay xakameysaa meesha nooc ka mid ah Baby Globe lagu soo bandhigi doono, mana xakameyso furaha muuqaalka ee Habka Dhalashada.
U oggolow Baby Globe inuu soo muuqdo iyadoo loo eegayo shaandhooyinka gaarka ah ee dhaqdhaqaaqyada Baby Globe
U oggolow Baby Globe inuu ka soo muuqdo oo keliya bogagga la doortay
Dami Baby Globe oo keliya bogagga la doortay (taas oo si wax ku ool ah uga dhigan in laga hawlgeliyo meel kasta marka laga reebo bogagga la doortay)
Iyada oo ku xiran Nooca shaandhaynta, goobtan waa la iska indho tiri karaa, waxay u shaqayn kartaa sidii liis oggolaansho, ama waxay u shaqayn kartaa sidii liis xannibaad
communityconfiguration-wp25eastereggs-mo: Shaandhooyinka gaarka ah ee dhaqdhaqaaqyada Baby Globe

Habee dhaqdhaqaaqyada Baby Globe ee ka soo muuqanaya bogag gaar ah. Ka eeg [https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia_25/Easter_egg_experiments/article_configuration bogga MetaWiki] maktabadda buuxda ee dhaqdhaqaaqyada.
communityconfiguration-wp25eastereggs-ph: Marka bogga la furo, Baby Globe wuxuu ku dul rogrogtaa taleefan isagoo leh muuqaal dhexdhexaad ah.
Ka hawlgeli/dami xaaladdan BabyGlobe ee ku jirta bogag hore loo sii qeexay
Waxay ku darsataa bogag dheeraad ah liiska hore loo sii qeexay ee bogagga haddii kuwaas la hawlgeliyo. Waxay oggolaanaysaa oo keliya bogagga la doortay haddii liiska hore loo sii qeexay la damiyo.
Waxay ka saartaa bogag ka mid ah isku darka liiska hore loo sii qeexay ee bogagga iyo oggolaanshaha dheeraadka ah.
